# Contributing

Thanks for your interest in improving P1S-GCODE.

## How to contribute

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a branch for your change
3. Keep changes focused and well-described
4. Open a pull request with context and testing notes

## Pull request checklist

- Explain what changed and why
- Include before/after behavior
- Keep formatting and naming consistent

## Issues

When opening issues, include reproduction steps and relevant printer/firmware details.
